questions.target: explained how... + in which 定语从句
questions.skill: 分清主句、宾语从句与先行词
questions.q: The engineer explained how a water-filter design had spread from research laboratories to neighborhood workshops, in which local volunteers built simple filters. Which account matches the sentence?
o: The volunteers moved the laboratories into their neighborhood.
The design reached workshops where volunteers constructed filters.
The engineer alone made every filter inside the research labs.
The water-filter design fell physically between two buildings.

exp.trans: 工程师解释了一种净水设计如何从研究实验室推广到社区工作坊，当地志愿者在这些工作坊制作简易滤水器。
exp.structure: explained后是how引导的宾语从句，design是该从句主语，had spread为谓语；in which引导定语从句，回指workshops。
exp.other: water filter 净水器；laboratory 实验室；workshop 工作坊；local volunteer 本地志愿者。
exp.meaning: 不能把物品技术的传播理解成实物降落；in which = in the neighborhood workshops，不等于in the research laboratories。
exp.rest: 没有说实验室被搬迁，也没有说所有滤水器由工程师独做；物理下落误解spread的传播含义。

questions.target: assume that ... did not / 被批评的信念
questions.q: A restaurant owner rebuked an apprentice for assuming that the online booking page did not influence walk-in customers. Surveys showed that many visitors discovered the restaurant through the page. What did the apprentice mistakenly believe?
o: The owner had avoided creating an online booking page.
Walk-in customers were unaffected by the booking page.
Customers preferred online orders to meals at the restaurant.
The owner placed excessive importance on online advertising.

exp.trans: 老板批评学徒，因为学徒以为网上订位页面不影响未经预约直接到店的人；调查却显示不少访客就是经此页面了解餐厅。
exp.structure: rebuked an apprentice为主干，for assuming that...说明批评原因，that后的did not influence是学徒持有的错误判断。
exp.other: rebuke 责备；apprentice 学徒；walk-in customer 无预约上门顾客；reservation 预约。
exp.meaning: assume/imagine that表示以为、认为；否定词位于从句中，决定被批评的是低估作用而非对网络的痴迷。
exp.rest: 老板未建网页和顾客点餐偏好均无证据；把老板说成过分重视广告，也没有回答学徒错误地否认网页对临时到店顾客的影响。

questions.target: who 定语从句 / that 宾语从句
questions.skill: who 定语从句 + that 宾语从句 + 主句谓语
questions.q:
Residents who discovered that the shared gate was unlocked called the caretaker.
按“主句主语中心词 / who从句谓语 / 主句谓语”的顺序，哪组正确？
o: Residents / discovered / called
the shared gate / discovered / was
Residents / was unlocked / discovered
the caretaker / called / discovered

exp.trans: 发现公共大门没有锁上的住户给管理员打了电话。
exp.structure: 简单句①Residents called the caretaker. ②Residents discovered something. ③The shared gate was unlocked. → 把③接在discovered后：Residents discovered that the shared gate was unlocked. → 把重复的Residents换成who并嵌入①：Residents [who discovered [that the shared gate was unlocked]] called the caretaker。主句完整主语包含who从句，中心词是Residents。
exp.other: resident 住户；shared 共用的；unlocked 没锁上的；caretaker 管理员。
exp.meaning: 发现这件事的是住户；没有锁上的是大门；打电话给管理员的还是住户。三个小句的主语和谓语不能串层。
exp.rest: the shared gate只在that从句中作主语，不能升为主句主语。was unlocked属于that从句，discovered属于who从句；两者都不是主句谓语。the caretaker是called的宾语，不是发现大门未锁的人。

questions.target: mark out of / graded on scale
questions.q: Every project is marked out of 50 by two independent reviewers. What is the meaning of marked in this sentence?
o: 贴上颜色标签
被随机地分组
按满分制评分
从项目中挑选

exp.trans: 每个项目由两名独立评审员按照50分满分进行打分。
exp.structure: Every project是主语，is marked是被动谓语，out of 50说明满分标准；by引出评分的施事者two independent reviewers。
exp.other: project 项目；independent reviewer 独立评审员；grade 评分；full marks 满分。
exp.meaning: marked在考试或项目评审语境中表示评分、批改，out of + 数值指定最高可得分；不要机械理解为划线标记。
exp.rest: out of 50给评分满分，两位reviewers执行评审；贴标签、随机分组和挑选项目都没有表达这一评分关系。

questions.q: A paragraph begins: “Overall, the first phase cut waiting times but raised operating costs.” The article then spends two more paragraphs discussing why costs rose. What does Overall most likely do here?
o: It announces the final conclusion of the entire article.
It sums up the first phase before further cost analysis.
It introduces an example unrelated to the first phase.
It signals doubt about the first phase's reported results.

exp.trans: 段落开头说：“总体来看，第一阶段缩短了等待时间，但提高了运营成本。”随后文章又用两段分析成本为何上升。这里 Overall 最可能是在进一步分析之前概括第一阶段的总体结果。
exp.structure: 引号内主干：the first phase（主语）+ cut / raised（并列谓语）+ waiting times / operating costs（宾语）。Overall修饰整句判断，表示概括性评价；后文仍可继续展开。
exp.other: phase 阶段；waiting time 等待时间；operating cost 运营成本；further analysis 进一步分析。
exp.meaning: Overall是句子/段落层面的总结副词，表示“总体而言”；它不等于“全文到此结束”。
exp.rest: 后文还要分析成本，不能判为全文终结；这句话概括第一阶段而非引入无关例子；Overall本身不表示对结果存疑。

questions.q: A catalogue lists woodcuts of birds beside photographs of birds. The pictures show similar species. What distinction does the catalogue make?
o: The two groups use different methods of making images.
Only the woodcuts can show more than one kind of bird.
The photographs must show birds made out of wood.
Only the photographs can be printed on sheets of paper.

exp.trans: 目录将鸟类木刻版画与鸟类照片并列，画面物种类似。目录区分的是什么？
exp.structure: of birds在两类图像里都表示主题；woodcuts和photographs区分媒介，不区分是否能出现鸟类或纸张。
exp.other: catalogue目录；species物种；method方法。
exp.meaning: woodcuts是woodcut的复数；同一主题能用不同媒介呈现。
exp.rest: more than one kind添加单一物种限制；birds made out of wood把主题误成材质；Only photographs...paper忽略木刻版画也能印在纸上。

questions.q: When a venue lost its accessible entrance, advance bookings took a sharp hit. The writer is describing the effect on reservations, not an injury. Which reading fits?
o: Bookings suffered a substantial setback after access was reduced.
A sharp object damaged the paper used to record the reservations.
Reservations rose suddenly because the new entrance was easier to use.
All bookings became permanently impossible at every venue in the city.

exp.trans: 场馆失去无障碍入口后，预订受到严重冲击。作者描述的是对预约的影响，并非身体受伤。如何理解？
exp.structure: When给出背景改变；bookings是受到影响的对象；took a hit表示遭受不利影响，sharp描述冲击程度。
exp.other: venue场馆；accessible entrance无障碍入口；advance booking提前预订；setback挫折。
exp.meaning: 把完整搭配与受影响对象结合，理解为预订遭受明显挫折，而非逐词拼成尖锐物体击打。
exp.rest: sharp object与reservations的抽象对象不符；rose和easier同时反转原文方向；all/every/permanently从单一场馆的严重影响扩大为全城永久不可能。

questions.q:
The archive contains several letters. The historian based her argument on those letters.
最自然的合并是：
o: The archive contains several letters on which the historian based her argument.
The archive contains several letters which on the historian based her argument.
The archive contains several letters on that the historian based her argument.
The archive contains several letters which the historian based her argument on them.

diag.1: 介词 on 应放在关系代词 which 前，不能写 which on the historian...
diag.2: 介词后不能用关系代词 that；应使用 which。
diag.3: which 已经代替 those letters，后面再用 them 造成重复。

exp.trans: 这个档案馆收藏着几封信，历史学家正是依据这些信件提出了她的论证。
exp.structure: 原始简单句：The historian based her argument on those letters. → those letters 变成先行词 several letters，并用 which 代替：the letters which the historian based her argument on → 正式写法把介词前置：the letters on which the historian based her argument。
exp.other: archive 档案馆；historian 历史学家；base A on B 以B为依据建立A；argument 论证/观点。
exp.meaning: 介词 + which 用于物；介词来自原简单句中的搭配 base A on B。
exp.rest: 介词前置的正确句是 “letters on which ...”；把 which 放在 on 前、把 that 放在介词后，或在 which 后再保留 them，都会造成词序或关系词重复问题。

figurative-descent-relative.target: descend 比喻从高端走向大众
figurative-descent-relative.skill: 熟词语义在传播路径中的变化
figurative-descent-relative.q: A monitoring technique once restricted to specialist hospitals gradually descended into community clinics as costs fell. In context, 'descended' suggests that the technique:
o: Spread beyond specialist centres into routine local care.
Moved physically downstairs within specialist hospitals.
Lost official approval for use in specialist hospitals.
Fell out of use in clinics because its price declined.

exp.trans: 一种最早限于专科医院的监测技术，随着成本降低而逐渐普及到社区诊所。
exp.structure: A monitoring technique is subject; descended is predicate; once restricted to... identifies original level and into community clinics shows destination.
exp.other: monitoring technique 监测技术；specialist 专科的；community clinic 社区诊所；outlaw 禁止。
exp.meaning: descend的本义是下降，但搭配高端领域到大众场景的路径时，可理解成技术或潮流的层级下沉传播。
exp.rest: 这里描述技术使用范围扩大，不是物理位置下降；进入社区诊所不等于失去许可或停止使用，后两者反而与传播方向冲突。

belief-negation-clause.target: imagined that ... had not / 提取完整观点
belief-negation-clause.skill: 信念内容不能由后续结果倒推
belief-negation-clause.q: Noor imagined that a software update had not changed her machine's output. Later measurements showed a substantial change. Which statement describes Noor's initial belief?
o: She initially thought the update made no difference.
She had decided to replace the machine entirely.
She knew from the beginning that output had changed greatly.
She was excessively enthusiastic about software updates.

exp.trans: Noor起初认为更新没有改变机器产出，后来的测量才发现变化明显。
exp.structure: Noor imagined that...中that从句作宾语；had not changed是其核心否定谓语；Later measurements引出相反事实。
exp.other: output 产出；substantial 显著的；measurement 测量；initial 初始的。
exp.meaning: 必须区分人物当时相信什么与后来实际发现了什么；不能只因出现update就推定其对软件痴迷。
exp.rest: 更换机器无依据；把后来证据当成最初已知事实颠倒时间；过分热衷更新是附加心理描述。

nested.skill: 区分定语从句、宾语从句和主句谓语
nested.q: Engineers who noticed that the valve was leaking shut down the line. Which sequence gives the main-clause subject head / who-clause verb / main-clause verb?
o: Engineers / noticed / shut down
the valve / noticed / was leaking
Engineers / was leaking / noticed
the line / shut down / noticed

exp.trans: 注意到阀门漏液的工程师关闭了生产线。按题目要求的顺序，主句主语中心词是Engineers，who从句谓语是noticed，主句谓语是shut down。
exp.structure: 主句骨架是Engineers shut down the line；who noticed...修饰Engineers；that the valve was leaking是noticed的宾语从句。三个谓语分别属于不同层级。
exp.other: engineer 工程师；valve 阀门；leak 漏液；shut down 关闭、停运；subject head 主语中心词。
exp.meaning: 先找主句骨架，再把who定语从句和that宾语从句分别嵌入。阀门是that从句的主语，工程师才是主句主语。
exp.rest: the valve只在that从句中作主语；was leaking属于that宾语从句，不是who从句谓语；the line是shut down的宾语，不是主句主语。

nested.skill: 区分定语从句、宾语从句和主句谓语
nested.q: Editors who learned that the quote was inaccurate removed it from the draft. Which sequence gives the main-clause subject head / who-clause verb / main-clause verb?
o: Editors / learned / removed
the quote / learned / was
Editors / was / learned
the draft / removed / learned

exp.trans: 得知引文不准确的编辑把它从草稿中删掉了。主句主语中心词是Editors，who从句谓语是learned，主句谓语是removed。
exp.structure: 主句骨架是Editors removed it from the draft；who learned...修饰Editors；that the quote was inaccurate是learned的宾语从句。三个谓语属于不同层级。
exp.other: editor 编辑；quote 引文；inaccurate 不准确的；draft 草稿。
exp.meaning: 先找主句骨架，再把who定语从句和that宾语从句分别嵌入。quote是that从句的主语，Editors才是主句主语。
exp.rest: the quote只在that从句中作主语；was属于that宾语从句，不是who从句谓语；the draft是介词from的宾语，不是主句主语。

nested.target: whatever + 名词 / 嵌入式修饰结构
nested.skill: 名词短语内部结构与主句宾语
nested.q: The workshop lets each visiting researcher retain whatever equipment they brought for the project. Which analysis is accurate?
o: The phrase is the subject of lets and refers to the researcher.
The whole phrase is the object of retain; whatever determines equipment.
The phrase is a direct question asking what equipment was brought.
The phrase modifies workshop and explains why the visit occurred.

exp.trans: 工作坊允许每位来访研究人员保留自己为项目带来的任何设备。whatever equipment they brought for the project整体作retain的宾语。
exp.structure: 主句骨架：The workshop lets each visiting researcher retain something。whatever equipment they brought for the project替换something，整体是retain的宾语；whatever限定equipment，they brought for the project修饰equipment。
exp.other: workshop工作坊；visiting researcher来访研究人员；retain保留；equipment设备。
exp.meaning: whatever + 名词可表示“任何……/所……的任何东西”。先识别整个名词短语在主句中的位置，再分析短语内部的限定词和修饰从句。
exp.rest: 主句主语是The workshop，不是whatever短语；这里不是直接疑问句；whatever短语不修饰workshop，也不说明访问原因。

nested.target: whatever + 名词 / 整体作宾语
nested.skill: 名词性结构与从句内部关系
nested.q: The registrar will accept whatever documents the applicant submits before Friday. What role does the underlined phrase play?
o: It is the object of accept: any documents the applicant submits.
It is the subject of submits and refers to the registrar.
It asks which documents the applicant may submit.
It modifies Friday and explains the reason for the deadline.

exp.trans: 登记员会接受申请人在周五之前提交的任何文件。whatever documents the applicant submits整体作accept的宾语。
exp.structure: 主句：The registrar will accept something。whatever documents the applicant submits before Friday整体替代something，作accept的宾语；the applicant submits是修饰documents的限定性关系结构，documents是submits的宾语。
exp.other: registrar登记员；applicant申请人；submit提交；deadline截止时间。
exp.meaning: whatever + 名词表示任何符合后续限定的该类事物；整个短语可以在主句中作宾语。要区分外层动词accept与内层从句谓语submits。
exp.rest: underlined phrase不是submits的主语，内层主语是the applicant；这不是直接疑问句；Friday是before的宾语，不是被whatever短语修饰的对象，也没有说明截止原因。

prompt_marks.text: whatever documents the applicant submits before Friday

cloze-score-marked.target: be marked out of + 满分
cloze-score-marked.q: The licensing exam is ______ out of 200 points, and a candidate needs at least 140 points to pass. Which word fits?
o: introduced
marked
selected
recruited

exp.trans: 资格考试以200分为满分评分，考生至少需要140分才能通过。
exp.structure: The licensing exam是主语，is marked为被动谓语，out of 200 points表示计分满分；and后分句说明及格分数。
exp.other: licensing exam 资格考试；candidate 考生；pass 通过；points 分数。
exp.meaning: mark既能表示做标记，也能表示批改、评分；be marked out of 200 points表示以200分为满分计分。
exp.rest: introduced是被引入，不表示计分；selected是被选中，recruited是被招募，都不能和out of 200 points自然说明评分标准。

summary-location.target: 局部总结 / 段尾钩子
summary-location.q: A paragraph says: “Taken together, the short trials show that the sensor detects small leaks. That finding raises a further question: can it operate for weeks without a battery change?” Which next paragraph would best develop the hook?
o: A report of a month-long run and its power use.
A repetition of the first trial’s one-hour detection rate.
A history of the material used in the first sensor.
A claim that accurate detection already proves long battery life.

exp.trans: 一段写道：“短期试验合起来表明传感器能检测到小泄漏。这个发现引出进一步的问题：不换电池，它能否运行数周？”最能展开段尾钩子的是长达一个月的运行和耗电报告。
exp.structure: Taken together概括short trials；the sensor + detects + small leaks是that宾语从句。That finding回指检测结果。can it operate...?的问题将检测能力推进到长期供电能力。
exp.other: trial 试验；leak 泄漏；operate 运转；power use 耗电量。
exp.meaning: 局部总结不是全文封口。选下一段要回应新的运行时长问题，而非机械重复已总结的检测准确性。
exp.rest: one-hour detection rate只重复旧测试，未回答数周运行；material history转去材料背景，未接耗电问题；accurate detection proves long battery life把检测能力当成续航证据，两项指标不能自动互证。

summary-location.target: 总结范围 / 后续核验
summary-location.q: After presenting a commuter survey, a paragraph says: “To sum up, the new schedule suits many commuters. The council will review it after winter, when school travel patterns change.” What do these lines support?
o: The winter review has already overturned the survey findings.
The council has changed the discussion to the cost of new buses.
The paragraph summarises current findings and identifies a later check.
The survey has measured how school journeys changed during the coming winter.

exp.trans: 在呈现通勤调查后，一段写道：“总的说来，新时刻表适合许多通勤者。委员会将在冬季之后重新评估它，届时学生出行规律会变化。”这些句子总结当前发现，并提出之后的核验。
exp.structure: To sum up引入对已给调查的概括。The new schedule + suits + many commuters。The council + will review + it表达将来的评估；when从句补充冬后出行规律变化。
exp.other: commuter 通勤者；schedule 时刻表；review 重新评估；travel pattern 出行规律。
exp.meaning: 总结当前部分与计划未来检查可以同段共存；未来检查还未发生。单靠总结词或后续计划，不能保证这一段必为全文末段或必有下一段。
exp.rest: already overturned把未来复核改成已完成的推翻；cost of new buses凭空替换主题；has measured ... coming winter把尚未来到的时期说成已取得观测结果。

woodcut-medium.q: In a workshop, an artist removes parts of a wooden block, inks the raised surface and presses paper onto it. The resulting image is a woodcut. What is it?
o: A three-dimensional figure shaped from a solid wooden log.
A coloured picture painted directly onto a wooden board.
A pencil drawing copied from the grain of a wooden plank.
A printed image made from the raised parts of carved wood.

exp.trans: 艺术家刻去木版的部分，在凸起表面上墨，再压上纸，得到woodcut。它是什么？
exp.structure: removes→inks→presses是制作过程；The resulting image指纸上印出的图像，而非原始木块。
exp.other: raised凸起的；ink着墨；grain木纹。
exp.meaning: woodcut是木刻版画；制作媒介和画面内容分开，不是所有雕木制品或木面图像都属于版画。
exp.rest: three-dimensional figure是立体木雕；painted directly是直接绘画；pencil drawing是铅笔画，均缺少木版着墨压印。

sharp-hit-impact.q: Losing its only rehearsal room dealt a sharp hit to the choir's preparations, though rehearsals continued elsewhere. What does sharp hit describe?
o: A literal blow delivered with a tool that had a sharpened edge.
A slight improvement in the quality of the choir's preparations.
A serious disruption without implying that all activity stopped.
A final cancellation of every rehearsal and every public performance.

exp.trans: 失去唯一排练室给合唱团的准备工作造成严重冲击，但排练仍在别处继续。sharp hit表示什么？
exp.structure: dealt...to...建立事件对准备工作的不利影响；though限制严重冲击不等于所有活动都终止。
exp.other: rehearsal排练；choir合唱团；disruption扰乱；deliver a blow造成打击。
exp.meaning: 这里hit是不利冲击，sharp加重程度；抽象语境不能套成锋利工具的击打，也不能擅自扩大为完全停摆。
exp.rest: literal blow把比喻硬译为物理动作；improvement反转影响方向；final cancellation忽略排练继续这一明确限定。

relative.q:
The plumber thanked the neighbour. He had borrowed a ladder from the neighbour.
哪句合并正确？
o: The plumber thanked the neighbour from that he had borrowed a ladder.
The plumber thanked the neighbour whom from he had borrowed a ladder.
The plumber thanked the neighbour from whom he had borrowed a ladder.
The plumber thanked the neighbour whom he had borrowed a ladder from him.

exp.trans: 水管工感谢了那位借梯子给他的邻居。
exp.structure: 原始简单句：He had borrowed a ladder from the neighbour. → 用whom替代重复的the neighbour：the neighbour whom he had borrowed a ladder from → 把from前置：the neighbour from whom he had borrowed a ladder。外层主干是The plumber + thanked + the neighbour，后接修饰neighbour的定语从句。
exp.other: plumber 水管工；neighbour 邻居；ladder 梯子；borrow A from B 从B那里借来A。
exp.meaning: from不是临时猜出来的，来自原句borrow...from...；先行词是人，介词后用whom。
exp.rest: from that：关系代词that不能直接置于介词后。whom from he：介词前置时必须是from whom，不是whom from。from him：关系代词whom已经代替该人，再保留him造成重复。
